text: The **MGAP forest map 2021** (source from Uruguay’s Ministry of Livestock, Agriculture and Fisheries) identifies the 2021 loss area as a **pine plantation**. It reports that 68.1 ha of the 81.3-ha loss area was planted forest, specifically *Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*. No native forest was present in the affected area, confirming it was a managed plantation. This aligns with the broader asset classification in the MGAP dataset.
